title: お腹ぺこぺこの秘密地図と、夜明けのラジオ・レシピ
author: 春宮こより

en.title: The Hungry Secret Map and the Dawn Radio Recipes
en.premise: I'm a high school girl with an appetite that just won't quit. One day, I discover a 'Secret Map of Local Gourmet Delicacies' tucked inside an old book in the library. Determined to visit every spot on the map, I force the blunt president of the Cooking Club to be my partner, and together we race across town with our hearts and stomachs in overdrive. A high-energy rom-com where the joy of eating and feelings for an awkward boy grow side-by-side!

zh.title: 肚子餓餓的秘密地圖與黎明的電台食譜
zh.premise: 「我」是一個食慾旺盛的高中生，某天在圖書室的古書中發現了一張「城鎮在地絕品美食秘密地圖」。為了將地圖上的美食全部吃遍，我強行指名那位冷淡的料理研究會部長擔任我的搭檔，讓胃口與心跳全力運轉，在城鎮中奔波。品嚐美食的喜悅與對笨拙的他所產生的戀情同時膨脹，這是一部全力以赴的食慾戀愛喜劇！
